versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Kling 3.0 skill for RunComfy, supporting all six Kling 3.0 endpoints.
- Covers Standard, Pro, and 4K rendering tiers with both text-to-video and image-to-video modes.
- Enables generation of multi-shot cinematic video with synchronized audio and consistent character identity.
- Includes unified input schema, mode/tier selection guidance, pricing breakdown, and usage examples.
- Requires RunComfy CLI, account (or token), and source image URLs for image-to-video modes.
